test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pamila is the granddaughter of Akun who is married to Nikita. Murali is the brother-in-law of Akun who has two daughters but no son. Rahul is the cousin of Kamal and brother of Pamila. Uday and Vanmay are the sons-in-law of Nikita. Vanmay is married to Yamini and they have two daughters and one son. Uday has one son and one daughter. Tina and Smita are the daughters of Yamini. Murali is unmarried. How is Yamini related to Rahul?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/820640455d2561154cca106a6fd6c43b18d10d15f60efe6faff41168866f0678.png] 

1) Pamila is the granddaughter of Akun who is married to Nikita.

2) Murali is the brother-in-law of Akun who has two daughters but no son.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc34262a34d761ca1ca4d2a44cd49fcd3c3b017a54e5d2279eb8ca2bc1e97a36.png] 

3) Uday and Vanmay are the sons-in-law of Nikita.

4) Vanmay is married to Yamini and they have two daughters and one son.

5) Uday has one son and one daughter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5143103adcadcc08c36d8595088a5b0fcfdf0c9e086f23d28bde2a6f2f9e5db.png] 

6) Tina and Smita are the daughters of Yamini.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54e7053c6a77b6199cea46c6d4fecb77d5cf126978f92e61de84356a223fb223.png] 

7) Rahul is the cousin of Kamal and brother of Pamila.

8) Murali is unmarried.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbdc78db798b6c9c30c207693a8c0b3b24abb53243c120d0d9fe2add55ec5ef5.png] 

Hence, Yamini is **"Aunt"** of Rahul.
